author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹಣಕೂಡಿ ಬಂದಾಗ ತಲೆತಿರುಗು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ
ಗುಣಿಯಾಗೆ ಹಣದೊಡನೆ ಜೀವನವೆ ಧನ್ಯ
ಸೆಣೆಸುವಿಕೆ ಸಹಜನಡೆ ಬದುಕಮೂಸೆಯ ಜನ್ಯ
ಧಣಿಯಾಗು ನಿನಗೆನೀ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When money comes along, it is common for the head to spin;
life is blessed if you are virtuous along with money;
struggle is a natural walk, born of life’s crucible;
be master of yourself, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Wealth easily goes to our heads. With virtue alongside it, life is blessed. Struggle is natural; the real task is mastering oneself.
